description: This file defines extension methods for the string class to facilitate code generation in C#, specifically for creating syntax expressions for string literals and identifiers using the Microsoft.CodeAnalysis API.

classes.name: StringExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for the string class to support code generation tasks such as creating literal expressions and identifiers.

methods.name: GetLiteralExpression
methods.description: Converts a string into a SyntaxFactory LiteralExpressionSyntax representing a string literal in C# syntax.

methods.name: ToIdentifier
methods.description: Converts a string into a SyntaxFactory SyntaxToken representing an identifier, handling C# keywords by creating verbatim identifiers.

methods.name: EscapeIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the string escaped as a C# identifier, prefixing with '@' if it is a C# keyword.

methods.name: ToIdentifierName
methods.description: Converts a string into a SyntaxFactory IdentifierNameSyntax object.
